title: Paste study plan
instructions: Paste a JSON v1 plan. Review the days, their activities, and the categories before creating the calendar.
uncertain: Creation is unconfirmed. Retry with the same plan to recover the result.
inactive_categories: These categories are inactive. Activate them or remove them from the JSON and review again: {{names}}.
categories_changed: Categories changed since you reviewed the plan. Review it again to confirm which categories will be created.
copy_manual: You can select and copy the template manually.
agent_template:
Return only a valid JSON object for the study calendar. Keep version: 1. For a numbered calendar, use schedule.kind "numbered", schedule.days and days[].day. For a dated calendar, use schedule.kind "dated", schedule.start, schedule.end and days[].date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Both dates are included. Each activity may have an HTTPS source with label and url. Omit completed, IDs, and any fields outside the example.

{{example}}

errors.empty: Paste the plan JSON to review it.
errors.invalid_json: This text is not valid JSON. Check the quotes and commas.
errors.payload_size: The plan exceeds the size of a single import. Reduce its content and review it again.
errors.invalid_version: The plan must include version with a value of 1.
errors.invalid_field: Check the {{field}} field. It may be missing, invalid, or unsupported.
errors.date_range: The end date must be on or after the start date. The range supports up to 366 days.
errors.duplicate_category: The plan includes duplicate categories. Keep one entry per name.
errors.duplicate_day: This day appears more than once in the plan.
errors.day_outside_schedule: This day is outside the calendar range.
